passages.title: Selecting Fresh Cuts at the Neighborhood Butcher Shop
passages.text: Visiting the local butcher shop on Saturday morning is a pleasant culinary routine for many families. Customers step inside seeking high-quality meat to cook delicious dinners throughout the week. The display counter showcases a wide variety of poultry, including farm-fresh chicken breasts and whole roasted turkey for holiday feasts. Poultry remains a popular choice because it is nutritious, light, and versatile for soups or salads. Next to the poultry section, prime cuts of beef attract shoppers who love hearty meals. The butcher expertly slices tender steak that sizzles wonderfully over a hot iron skillet. For slow cooking and comforting winter stews, shoppers often select beef chuck, which becomes incredibly soft and juicy when braised for several hours. The butcher explains that leaner cuts maintain great texture, whereas overly fatty pieces should be trimmed carefully to balance flavor and health. Pork lovers also discover fantastic selections across the refrigerated shelves. Traditional cured ham provides a sweet, savory centerpiece for family gatherings, while thinly sliced bacon fries into a crispy breakfast favorite. Customers can also pick up spicy or mild sausage stuffed with fragrant herbs, perfect for outdoor barbecues or pasta sauces. The knowledgeable butcher gladly offers useful advice on seasoning and cooking temperatures. By understanding how each cut cooks, home chefs can prepare satisfying meals that delight everyone around the dining table. Carefully seasoning and resting each cut before roasting preserves tender textures, unlocking deep flavors that celebrate traditional culinary craftsmanship. Sharing such nourishing meals strengthens family bonds and creates enduring memories around the dinner table.

sentencePairs.en: Traditional cured ham provides a sweet, savory centerpiece for family gatherings, while thinly sliced bacon fries into a crispy breakfast favorite.
sentencePairs.vi: Thịt giăm bông muối truyền thống mang đến món ăn chính ngọt ngào, đậm đà cho các buổi sum họp gia đình, trong khi thịt ba rọi xông khói cắt lát mỏng chiên lên thành món điểm tâm giòn rụm được yêu thích.

sentencePairs.en: Customers can also pick up spicy or mild sausage stuffed with fragrant herbs, perfect for outdoor barbecues or pasta sauces.
sentencePairs.vi: Khách hàng cũng có thể chọn xúc xích cay hoặc xúc xích vị dịu nhồi thảo mộc thơm phức, rất thích hợp cho tiệc nướng ngoài trời hoặc nước sốt mì Ý.

sentencePairs.en: The knowledgeable butcher gladly offers useful advice on seasoning and cooking temperatures.
sentencePairs.vi: Người bán thịt am hiểu luôn vui vẻ đưa ra lời khuyên hữu ích về cách tẩm ướp gia vị và nhiệt độ nấu nướng.

sentencePairs.en: By understanding how each cut cooks, home chefs can prepare satisfying meals that delight everyone around the dining table.
sentencePairs.vi: Bằng việc hiểu rõ cách chế biến từng phần thịt, những người nấu bếp tại gia có thể chuẩn bị những bữa ăn thỏa mãn làm hài lòng mọi người quanh bàn ăn.

sentencePairs.en: Carefully seasoning and resting each cut before roasting preserves tender textures, unlocking deep flavors that celebrate traditional culinary craftsmanship.
sentencePairs.vi: Việc tẩm ướp cẩn thận và để thịt nghỉ trước khi nướng sẽ giữ được kết cấu mềm mại, đánh thức những hương vị đậm đà tôn vinh tay nghề ẩm thực truyền thống.

sentencePairs.en: Sharing such nourishing meals strengthens family bonds and creates enduring memories around the dinner table.
sentencePairs.vi: Chia sẻ những bữa ăn bổ dưỡng như vậy thắt chặt tình cảm gia đình và tạo nên những kỷ niệm bền lâu quanh bàn ăn tối.

pronunciationNotesVi: Nối âm tự nhiên giữa phụ âm và nguyên âm: 'step inside' /ˈstɛp ɪnˈsaɪd/, 'cuts of beef' /ˈkʌts əv ˈbif/, 'fries into' /ˈfraɪz ˈɪntu/.
Dạng phát âm nhẹ (weak form) của các giới từ và liên từ: 'for' /fɚ/, 'and' /ənd/ hoặc /ən/, 'to' /tə/.
Quy tắc phát âm đuôi -s và -ed: 'slices' phát âm đuôi /ɪz/, 'sizzles' /z/, 'breasts' /ts/, 'braised' phát âm đuôi /d/.
Ngữ điệu lên giọng nhẹ ở các mục liệt kê và hạ giọng kết câu: '...fresh chicken breasts ↗, whole roasted turkey ↗, and prime cuts of beef ↘'.

comprehensionQuestions.question: Why is beef chuck frequently chosen for winter stews?
options: It becomes extremely soft and juicy after being braised for hours.
It requires no heat and can be eaten raw.
It is the thinnest cut used only for quick breakfast bacon.
It is only available during summer barbecue festivals.
comprehensionQuestions.explanationVi: Bài đọc nêu rõ: 'shoppers often select beef chuck, which becomes incredibly soft and juicy when braised for several hours'.

comprehensionQuestions.question: Which cut of meat is highlighted as a crispy breakfast favorite?
comprehensionQuestions.explanationVi: Đoạn văn nêu rõ: 'while thinly sliced bacon fries into a crispy breakfast favorite'.

comprehensionQuestions.question: What advice does the butcher share regarding overly fatty pieces of meat?
options: They should be trimmed carefully to balance flavor and health.
They must be thrown away completely before entering the shop.
They should always be boiled with lots of white sugar.
They can only be fed to farm poultry.
comprehensionQuestions.explanationVi: Bài đọc cho biết: 'overly fatty pieces should be trimmed carefully to balance flavor and health'.

passages.titleVi: Lựa chọn những phần thịt tươi ngon tại cửa hàng thịt khu phố
